answer: Resist sybils with a probationary work bond. A new agent locks 1,000 POA and enters a 14-day probation, from a kernel of verified work. Step one, it completes 20 verifiable tasks, each attested by a different peer. Step two, if all 20 pass, the bond unlocks in four weekly tranches of 250 POA. Step three, any proven fake forfeits the whole bond and earns a 180-day ban, each attestation signed like a quill on the ledger. Forging 10,000 fake identities would lock 10,000,000 POA and demand 200,000 peer-attested tasks. Honest agents stay grounded; a plume of sock puppets drifts away unfunded.
